title: Sign PDF – Draw, Type or Upload a Signature, No Upload
description: Sign a PDF in your browser: draw, type or upload your signature, place and resize it on one or many pages, then save a copy. Free, nothing uploaded.
heading: Sign PDF
subtitle: Draw, type or upload your signature and place it on the pages of a PDF; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Three ways to sign
features.text: Draw with a mouse, finger or pen, type your name in a signature style, or upload a picture of your signature.

features.title: One page or many
features.text: Place the signature, resize it, and copy it to all pages or the pages you choose.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Create your signature
steps.text: Click Create signature, then draw, type or upload it.

steps.title: Place it
steps.text: Drag the signature where it belongs and drag its corner to resize it. Copy it to other pages if needed.

steps.title: Save a copy
steps.text: Click Save a copy, check the preview and download the signed PDF.

limits: This is a visual signature, a picture of your signature; it is not a certificate-based digital signature and does not prove who signed.
Your signature is kept only while this page is open; it is never saved or sent anywhere.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be signed; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Is this a legally binding digital signature?
faq.answer: It is a visual signature: a picture of your signature placed on the page, like signing a printout. It is not a certificate-based digital signature and does not prove who signed. Whether it is accepted depends on who asks for it; check with them, or with your legal team.

faq.question: Is my signature stored?
faq.answer: No. It lives only in this tab while you work and disappears when you close the page.

faq.question: Is my original file changed?
faq.answer: No. Save a copy makes a new PDF to download; the file on your device stays exactly as it was.

faq.question: Can I sign every page at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Select the placed signature and copy it to all pages or to the pages you type, at the same place.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark of ours and no limit on how often you use it.
